images.alt: A family relaxing on a sandy patio bordered by a white picket fence that leads directly onto a beach

The view across the Pacific Ocean from a luxury oceanfront villa in Hawaii. The curved wooden pergola of the property is supported by decorative carved pillars, with a plunge pool and two lounge chairs visible in the foreground. An infinity pool looks out over the tranquil waters, while lush green palm trees and tropical foliage line the property edge.
